Apple targets June 2027 unveiling for AI smart glasses: report (AAPL:NASDAQ)
Apple may launch AI-powered smart glasses in 2027 with Siri at the centre
articles.excerpt:
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL, XETRA:APC) is reportedly preparing to enter the smart-glasses market in 2027 with an AI-powered device that will rely on its upgraded Siri assistant and a paired iPhone to handle most tasks.

The glasses, internally codenamed N50, are expected to be unveiled at the company’s Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2027, with shipments targeted before the end of the year, Bloomberg reported.

Unlike the Apple Vision Pro headset, the first-generation glasses are not expected to feature an augmented-reality display or operate as a standalone computing device.

articles.excerpt: Machine learning models, particularly large foundation models, are increasingly evaluated along multiple axes that are relevant for their usage. In addition to accuracy measures appropriate for the specific task of interest, measures capturing safety, calibration and fairness properties are often of interest. The classical approach to these problems assumes that the test set has been held out from the training process, an assumption that is increasingly harder to justify for large foundation models.
